learning_outcomes.text: The student can comment on the necessary methods for reducing the energy costs of sanitation system.
The student can express the legionary illness and how this illness can be prevented.
The student can define the energy saving precautions for fans and pumps.
The student can comment on the guality of inside air and the concepts of polluters.
The student can calculate the energy cost of heating systems.
The student can do the calculation of heat insulation.

syllabus_topics: Reduction of water consumption in clean water fitting.
The economy in water distribution and pressurazing systems and in hot water fittings.
The introduction of energy economics in air conditioning systems.
The main principles and the reduction of building cooling loads.
Energy savings in fans, air channels and pumps.
Energy savings in cooling groups, central and individual cooling systems.
The repetition of exam subjects must be done and the relevant problems must be solved.
Heat insulation, the system selection in heating and automation.
Alternative energies and benefits to the fuel economy.
The roof heat centers and economics.
